from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityEnrollment(BaseModel):
    """One university's enrollment record from a CDS document."""
    university_name: str = Field(description="The name of the university as reported")
    grand_total_enrollment: int = Field(description="The GRAND TOTAL ALL STUDENTS enrollment count")
    reporting_period: str = Field(description="The reporting period for this enrollment data in YYYY-MM format")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_enrollment_records: list[UniversityEnrollment]
